C1612.title: V2X Application Spoofing Platform (VASP) Framework Released
C1612.summary: Researchers have publicly released VASP, a framework designed to simulate attacks against V2X networks. Built on the VEINS simulation environment, it can emulate spoofing and misinformation injection attacks in vehicle-to-vehicle (V2V) and vehicle-to-infrastructure (V2I) communications, aiming to provide a testing tool for automotive cybersecurity research.
